findings.title: Device Authorization Verified
findings.description: Device Demo Phone is properly authorized.
findings.recommendation: Continue using explicit authorization for device access.

findings.title: Authorization Expiring Soon
findings.recommendation: Plan to re-authorize the device before expiry.

findings.title: Plaintext Authentication Enabled
findings.description: The /auth/plaintext endpoint sends passwords in cleartext.
findings.recommendation: Disable plaintext authentication or enforce HTTPS.

findings.title: Hashing Without Salt
findings.description: The /auth/hash endpoint uses SHA-256 without salt.
findings.recommendation: Use PBKDF2, bcrypt, or Argon2 with proper salting.

findings.title: Default API Key in Use
findings.recommendation: Generate and use a unique API key for production.

recommendations: Address all HIGH severity findings immediately.
Review application configuration for security best practices.
